task: Quarantine an irreconcilable startup batch without freezing unrelated banker traffic
resume_instruction: Startup batch 801bf00d has only 1/2 expected items on Central and currently makes HasUnresolvedDispatchWork reject every donation because it counts every queue row. Introduce an explicit non-dispatchable custody-hold state for incomplete startup custody, retain the batch and item evidence, and exclude only that state from the global donation gate.
